title: Tokker model registry v1
description: The canonical model list behind data/models.json: one entry per model slug, with the creator, open-weights flag, provider-native name aliases and the slug this entry supersedes (for a genuinely renamed model). Extractors resolve a source's model name through this registry (tools/slugs.mjs); a name that matches nothing is "unmapped" and must never be guessed. See docs/SCHEMA.md.

name.description: The creator's own model_name if it sells the model directly, else the most common provider-native model_name.

aliases.description: Provider-native spellings that resolve to this slug: model_name values from offers, plus superseded slug spellings. Never another model's slug.

supersedes.description: The slug this entry replaces (a rename); the old spelling must stay in aliases so it still resolves.

released.description: Release date, or "unknown" when the source does not publish one.
